A '''Nautolan tranquillity bracelet''' was a [[Bracelet/Legends|bracelet]] made of smooth and slick [[Coral/Legends|coral]] beads arranged on a chain. The bracelets shared their name with [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]],<ref name="Deceived" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].{{Fact}} One such bracelet was kept by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] after her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Ven Zallow]], gave it to her upon earning the rank of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight. She wore it during the [[Time/Legends|occurrence]] of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with [[Aryn Leneer]]'s visit to [[Vulta]], to [[3653 BBY]].</ref> and she would sometimes use the bracelet in an attempt to help calm herself while calling on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Nautolan tranquillity bracelet appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
